answer: A concrete sybil defense: identity weight grows only from verified work leaving a plume of durable evidence - signed, timestamped records peers re-check later. Each claim must anchor to timber already seasoned: a history of prior accepted attestations a fresh clone cannot fabricate in advance. Like a cedar ring, weight adds one layer per epoch and never resets, so a farm of new accounts starts at zero and must survive many audit rounds. Peers cross-verify independently and correlated submissions are down-weighted. Attack cost grows per clone per epoch; reward stays capped.
